يفترضون (form VIII)
# يَفْتَرِضُونَ (yaftariḍūna) /jaf.ta.ri.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# يُفْتَرَضُونَ (yuftaraḍūna) /juf.ta.ra.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
